Hi Sophie — thanks for sending the DDQ and the context. Quick answers and next steps from security: 

1) SOC 2 Type II: our last Type II audit period ended Oct 31, 2026. We can provide a redacted Type II report under a mutual NDA or provide a bridge letter in the interim; the attached one-page summary covers scope (storage, inference runtime, control categories).

2) HIPAA/PHI: Redwood does support customers that process PHI. We offer a BAA; legal can send a standard BAA for review if you indicate interest. Our platform can be configured to restrict persistence and to use customer-managed keys.

3) GDPR/data residency: we offer EU region hosting for EU-data-only workloads. We also provide a Data Processing Addendum (DPA) and standard SCCs on request.

4) DDQ ETA: I’ll assign two folks to complete the DDQ — target turnaround is 3 business days (we’ll return the completed spreadsheet by EOD Friday, Apr 9). If you need faster turnaround on specific rows, highlight them and we’ll prioritize.

5) Trust portal: I’ve provisioned temporary, time-limited access for Lifeline to the evidence portal. Invite link below — it is read-only and scoped to the artifacts we can share before an NDA. If you need the full Type II report we’ll send a DocuSign link for the standard disclosure NDA and then upload the redacted report.

Trust portal invite: https://trust.redwood.ai/secure/invite/ABCD-1234
Portal access notes: temporary credentials expire in 7 days; we can extend after identification of authorized users.

Attachments: redwood_bridge_letter_2027.pdf; soc2_summary_2026.pdf

If that works I’ll mark the DDQ rows for HIPAA and report access as high priority.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
